pattern: if {c:Cond} , instead search your library for {n:Qty} cards and put those cards into your hand

examples.text: Search your library for a card and put that card into your hand. If ~ was kicked, instead search your library for two cards and put those cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
Search your library for a card and put that card into your hand. If you control an Elf, instead search your library for three cards and put those cards into your hand. Then shuffle.

counterExamples: Search your library for a card and put that card into your hand. If ~ was kicked, search your library for two cards and put those cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
Draw a card. If ~ was kicked, instead search your library for two cards and put those cards into your hand.

pattern: if {c:Cond} , {p:Player} mill[s] twice that many cards instead

examples.text: Target player mills three cards. If ~ was kicked, that player mills twice that many cards instead.
Target opponent mills four cards. If you control an Elf, that player mills twice that many cards instead.

counterExamples: Target player mills three cards. If ~ was kicked, that player mills three times that many cards instead.
Target player mills three cards. If ~ was kicked, that player mills twice that many cards.
Target player mills three cards. If ~ was kicked, you mill twice that many cards instead.

pattern: {src:Obj} deal[s] damage equal to {n:Qty} to {to:Recipient} and that much damage to {r:Targets}
subject: none

examples.text: {2}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to target player and that much damage to up to one target creature.
When ~ enters, it deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target player and that much damage to up to one other target creature.

counterExamples: When ~ enters, it deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target player and that much damage to each creature.
When ~ enters, it deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target player and twice that much damage to up to one target creature.
When ~ enters, it deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target player or that much damage to up to one target creature.

pattern: whenever you discard one or more {f:Filter} for the first time each turn

examples.text: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn, you gain 2 life.
Whenever you discard one or more creature cards for the first time each turn, draw a card.

counterExamples: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, create a Junk token.
Whenever you discard a nonland card for the first time each turn, create a Junk token.
Whenever you sacrifice one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn, create a Junk token.
